evaluation.drawdownType: intraday-trailing: threshold = peak balance including unrealized P&L minus maxDrawdown; never moves down; breach when balance touches or falls below it

performanceAccount.dailyLossLimitEffect: pauses trading for the rest of the session; account stays open
performanceAccount.tiersNote: tier set from the prior session's closing balance (4:59:59 PM ET); profit = closing balance - 50000; never below Level 1

payout.consistencyNote: no single profitable day may be 50% or more of total profit since the last approved payout

performanceAccount.inactivity: at least two $50 net-profit days within 30 consecutive days

unverified: Tier boundary between Level 3 and 4 is printed as '$3,000 - $5,999' and '$5,999 & Up'; this file uses 6000 for Level 4.
Payout table columns are unlabeled on the page; 52100 is read as the safety net and 52600 as the minimum balance to request (safety net + $500 minimum payout).
